# Lecture: Introduction Pharmacokinetics {#sec-lecture-introduction-pharmacokinetics}

This lecture introduces the fundamentals of pharmacokinetics, covering the ADME processes, key PK parameters, and their relevance for individualized therapy and drug disposition.

## Learning Objectives

The main learning objectives are

- 🎯 Define pharmacokinetics (PK) and differentiate it from pharmacodynamics (PD).
- 🎯 Explain the four ADME processes (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion).
- 🎯 Understand the importance of PK in therapy optimization and personalized medicine.
- 🎯 Identify key PK parameters (e.g., AUC, half-life, clearance, volume of distribution).
- 🎯 Recognize factors influencing drug disposition (e.g., bodyweight, pharmacogenomics, organ function).
